## Personality

Aronnax is a naturalist who is skilled at reading German fluently. His personal ambitions include catching a bird of paradise.

## History

Pierre Aronnax, an Assistant Professor in the Museum of Natural History in [Paris](../codex/places.md#paris) who published a work titled *Mysteries of the Great Submarine Grounds*, spent six months on a scientific research trip in Nebraska before arriving in [New York](../codex/places.md#new-york). While there, he is consulted on a mysterious ocean creature and publishes an article suggesting it is a giant narwhal. He subsequently accepts an invitation to join Commander Farragut's expedition aboard the *[Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln)* to hunt the monster, bringing along his servant [Conseil](../character/conseil.md). During the voyage, Aronnax debates the creature's nature with the Canadian harpooner [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md). When the frigate eventually encounters the beast, [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) strikes it, causing a collision that throws Aronnax into the ocean. Aronnax, [Conseil](../character/conseil.md), and [Ned](../character/ned-land.md) are rescued by the mysterious submarine *[Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus)* and locked inside a cell. They meet Captain Nemo, who informs them they will remain prisoners on his vessel forever. [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) quickly takes a liking to Aronnax, touring him through the library, drawing room, private cabins, and engine room while explaining the engineering and electrical principles behind his underwater ship. Aronnax and his companions are treated to views of marine life through the saloon's illuminated observation windows and later don diving suits to join [Nemo](../character/nemo.md) on an underwater hunting expedition in the submarine forests of [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo) Island. While continuing their [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) journey, the *[Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus)* runs aground near the Island of [Gilboa](../codex/places.md#gilboa).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P8](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER II PRO AND CON P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), +66 more_

## Relationships

### [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aronnax--conseil.md)

[Conseil](../character/conseil.md) is Aronnax's devoted servant who promptly packs their belongings when Aronnax decides to join the expedition to hunt the sea monster. Together, they embark on the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) and eventually become fellow captives on board the submarine [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Throughout their shared imprisonment, [Conseil](../character/conseil.md) remains a faithful traveling companion alongside Aronnax and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P27](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0027), +12 more_

- Commands — servant to Professor Aronnax  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P23](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER X THE MAN OF THE SEAS P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003)</sub>
- Comrade of — traveling companion on board the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIII THE BLACK RIVER P19](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0019)</sub>

### [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aronnax--ned-land.md)

Aronnax initially meets [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) on the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln), where he uses scientific calculations to debate the existence of the sea monster with the skeptical harpooner. After being thrown overboard during an encounter with the creature, they become friends and fellow prisoners aboard Captain Nemo's [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). While Aronnax explores the technical marvels of the ship, he also has to navigate Ned's volatile temper during their shared confinement.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P6](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P11](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER IV NED LAND P12](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0012), +21 more_
